messages:
Jules CSM: Heads-up: Glacier Fleet wants to onboard three teams next month (Dispatch, Driver Assist, Support). They flagged two things: (1) regulatory requirement for a VPC/private deployment for driver PII, and (2) projected ~4x token throughput during peak after rollout. Asking immediate guidance on Dedicated vs Private and timeline.

Ravi AE: Interesting expansion signal. Renewal is in 6 months so this could move the commercial conversation sooner. Do they want a pilot or full private deployment?

Jules CSM: They asked to pilot Dedicated first, then move to Private if we meet latency & security checks. Also need production API keys and KMS integration. They saw 429s during yesterday's smoke tests.

Lin Support: Opened ticket SUP-889, captured 429 stack traces. Their client sends bursts of parallel requests with no jitter. Recommend token-bucket smoothing on client side + server-side rate-limit increase during pilot. KB: https://redwood.cloud/docs/rate-limits#best-practices

Keiko Eng: If they're expecting sustained 4x and want Private later, we need traffic shape: avg token length, embedding vs generation ratio, p50/p95 request latency, and typical burst length. Also need expected concurrency for Driver Assist (low latency requirement).

Jules CSM: They provided a sample trace csv. Highlights: median ~300 tokens, 95th ~1200 tokens; embeddings pipeline is heavy (estimated 70% of tokens), Driver Assist requires p95 < 400ms. Normal peak ~1800 reqs/min, stress tests hit ~7200 rpm. Sending file to @Keiko Eng & @Diego SE.

Diego SE: Sounds like embeddings-heavy. For a mixed workload with strict p95 SLAs we'll want a Dedicated pod tuned for embeddings + a Private deployment plan for data-in-flight controls. I'll draft a sizing + cost note and include quantization paths for embeddings (INT4/INT8).

Ravi AE: Please include a 1-week pilot with a break/fail safety clause. Finance wants committed spend brackets if they convert to Private. I'll start a commercial note.

infra-bot: Capacity ticket CAP-3111 opened: request +5 A100 equiv GPUs, autoscale window 06:00-22:00 UTC. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/capacity/CAP-3111

Lin Support: SSO/SCIM: their Okta org returns 412 on group sync for org 5512. Contacted their IdP admin; keeping SUP-889 active.

Keiko Eng: For Driver Assist latency, we can propose a hybrid: Dedicated for latency-sensitive endpoints (hot path) + Private for batch embeddings. That reduces Private footprint. Will simulate 4x load with prefix KV cache + dynamic batching and report numbers. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Diego SE: I'll prepare an enablement session focused on batching patterns and deployment checklist. Proposed time Thu 9am PT.

Jules CSM: Quick ask for the customer: can they split traffic by route (driver vs support) at the API gateway? If yes, we can size pods more efficiently. I'll ask in my reply.

Ravi AE: Also request an expected 90-day growth forecast and whether Driver Assist is pegged to real-time SLAs; that'll determine autoscale headroom.

Jules CSM: Noted. I'll collect split percentages and growth forecast.

Lin Support: Logged a mitigation: temporary token bucket throttle on our ingress for their org to reduce 429s while we tune capacity. SUP-889 updated.

Diego SE: For commercial, include optional add-ons: extended observability retention, dedicated oncall, and encryption-at-rest HSM integration. Those matter for Private deals.

Keiko Eng: After sim: initial results show 3.6x token throughput achievable with KV cache + batching; embeddings latency improved by ~40%. Post full sim tomorrow will confirm if we meet p95 < 400ms for Driver Assist.

Jules CSM: Thanks team. I'll update Glacier Fleet with the plan: pilot (1 week), enablement workshop, SCIM/SSO remediation, and a follow-up sim + capacity trial. Tagging SUP-889 & CAP-3111 in CRM and marking as "likely expansion".

Ravi AE: Great. I'll draft the pilot clause and loop Finance. Looks like a solid expansion opportunity. :rocket:

Jules CSM: I'll post the customer reply here when sent.

Lin Support: Will keep SUP-889 open and post Okta admin responses here.

Diego SE: Calendar invite for enablement sent.

Keiko Eng: Will post final sim numbers tomorrow.
